diagram.title: TPU state placement, HBM budget and compute path
diagram.prediction: What remains on each physical chip under replication versus explicit sharding, and where do BF16 operands enter?
diagram.reading: Training state may be replicated or sharded; this diagram treats placement as an explicit choice rather than assuming aggregate HBM is enough. The 48 GiB, four-v5e-chip case needs 48 GiB/device if replicated or 12 GiB/device under ideal even sharding, before activations and temporaries. Verify actual NamedSharding and live memory before claiming the latter placement. Inference KV cache is a separate scenario.
diagram.alt: Conceptual TPU per-device ledger: replicated training state is copied to every chip; explicitly sharded state is partitioned across chips; activations and temporaries use additional HBM; a separate inference path holds KV cache; BF16 operands stream from HBM to compute.
